mapper.insert: INSERT INTO career_project_profile (project_id, overall_score, best_role_code, difficulty, status, score_version, taxonomy_version, content_hash, last_verified_at, source_run_id) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{overallScore}, #{bestRoleCode}, #{difficulty}, #{status}, #{scoreVersion}, #{taxonomyVersion}, #{contentHash}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{sourceRunId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE overall_score = VALUES(overall_score), best_role_code = VALUES(best_role_code), difficulty = VALUES(difficulty), summary_zh = IF(content_hash <=> VALUES(content_hash) AND score_version = VALUES(score_version), summary_zh, NULL), career_value = IF(content_hash <=> VALUES(content_hash) AND score_version = VALUES(score_version), career_value, NULL), proof_points = IF(content_hash <=> VALUES(content_hash) AND score_version = VALUES(score_version), proof_points, NULL), interview_topics = IF(content_hash <=> VALUES(content_hash) AND score_version = VALUES(score_version), interview_topics, NULL), modification_plan = IF(content_hash <=> VALUES(content_hash) AND score_version = VALUES(score_version), modification_plan, NULL), main_risks = IF(content_hash <=> VALUES(content_hash) AND score_version = VALUES(score_version), main_risks, NULL), estimated_duration = IF(content_hash <=> VALUES(content_hash) AND score_version = VALUES(score_version), estimated_duration, NULL), status = CASE WHEN status = 'HIDDEN' THEN 'HIDDEN' WHEN VALUES(status) = 'INVALID' THEN 'INVALID' WHEN NOT (content_hash <=> VALUES(content_hash)) OR NOT (score_version <=> VALUES(score_version)) THEN 'CANDIDATE' ELSE status END, score_version = VALUES(score_version), taxonomy_version = VALUES(taxonomy_version), content_hash = VALUES(content_hash), last_verified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, source_run_id = VALUES(source_run_id)

INSERT INTO career_project_role_score (project_id, role_code, role_relevance, provable_ability, knowledge_coverage, portfolio_completeness, interview_value, total_score, job_sample_count, evidence_json, score_version) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{roleCode}, #{roleRelevance}, #{provableAbility}, #{knowledgeCoverage}, #{portfolioCompleteness}, #{interviewValue}, #{totalScore}, #{jobSampleCount}, CAST(#{evidenceJson} AS JSON), #{scoreVersion})
mapper.select: SELECT project_id, role_code, role_relevance, provable_ability, knowledge_coverage, portfolio_completeness, interview_value, total_score, job_sample_count, evidence_json, score_version FROM career_project_role_score WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY total_score DESC, role_code

mapper.update: UPDATE career_project_profile SET status = #{status}, hidden_reason = #{hiddenReason} WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO career_project_weekly_pick (week_start, project_id, rank_no, selection_source) VALUES (#{weekStart}, #{projectId}, #{rankNo}, #{selectionSource})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM career_project_weekly_pick wp JOIN career_project_profile cp ON cp.project_id = wp.project_id JOIN beginner_project bp ON bp.id = cp.project_id WHERE wp.week_start = #{weekStart} AND cp.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY wp.rank_no
